title: Xtra Power TCT Saw Blade, 6 Inch, 40 Teeth, for Wood Cutting (6 inch, 60 Teeth)
description: The Xtra Power TCT Saw Blade is a reliable and high-performance cutting tool designed for precision wood cutting tasks. Measuring 6 inches in diameter (approximately 15.24 cm) and featuring 40 finely crafted teeth, this blade delivers clean, smooth, and accurate cuts with every pass. The Tungsten Carbide Tipped (TCT) construction ensures exceptional durability and long-lasting sharpness, making it well-suited for both professional woodworkers and DIY enthusiasts alike. The 40-tooth configuration strikes an ideal balance between cutting speed and finish quality, allowing you to work efficiently through a variety of wood types, including hardwood, softwood, and engineered wood panels. The blade is engineered to reduce vibration during operation, resulting in greater control and a finer cut surface. Compatible with most standard circular saws, this Xtra Power TCT Saw Blade is a dependable addition to any workshop or job site toolkit. Whether you are working on furniture, cabinetry, or general carpentry projects, this blade is built to meet the demands of everyday cutting tasks with consistent performance.

specifications.Compatible Devices: Chop Saw, Circular Saw, Miter Saw, Table Saw
